qe: Given: A + B means A is the father of B; A - B means A is the daughter of B; A × B means A is the sister of B; A ÷ B means A is the husband of B. (i) If P × Q - R + S, then how is P related to S?
qh: दिया है: A + B का अर्थ है A, B का पिता है; A - B का अर्थ है A, B की पुत्री है; A × B का अर्थ है A, B की बहन है; A ÷ B का अर्थ है A, B का पति है। (i) यदि P × Q - R + S है, तो P का S से क्या संबंध है?
e:
Method 1 (Decoded Family Tree Shortcut):
Step 1: Expression ko break karein:
- P × Q → P, Q ki behan hai ($P^{(-)}$).
- Q - R → Q, R ki beti hai ($Q^{(-)}$).
- R + S → R, S ka pita hai ($R^{(+)}$).
Step 2: R ke bachhe P, Q, aur S hain. P mahila (female) hai aur S ki sagi behan hai.
Isliye P, S ki 'Sister' (बहन) hai.
Correct option (B) Sister hai.

Method 2 (Gender & Generation Inspection):
P × Q se P ka gender female (-) nirdharit hota hai, isliye Brother reject ho gaya. P aur S dono ek hi pita R ke bachhe hain (same generation), isliye Mother aur Daughter eliminate ho gaye. Keval Option (B) Sister sahi hai.
Sahi uttar (B) hai.

qe: Given: A + B means A is the father of B; A - B means A is the daughter of B; A × B means A is the sister of B; A ÷ B means A is the husband of B. (ii) In (i) if P × Q - R + S, what is the relationship of S with P?
qh: दिया है: A + B का अर्थ है A, B का पिता है; A - B का अर्थ है A, B की पुत्री है; A × B का अर्थ है A, B की बहन है; A ÷ B का अर्थ है A, B का पति है। (ii) (i) में यदि P × Q - R + S है, तो S का P से क्या संबंध है?
e:
Method 1 (Gender Ambiguity Shortcut Trick):
Step 1: P × Q - R + S me S ka gender check karein:
- R + S ka arth hai 'R pita hai S ka'.
- Yahan S ka gender (male ya female) prashn me nirdharit nahi hai.
Step 2: Chuki S, P ka sibling hai kintu uska ling spasht nahi hai, isliye S ya toh bhai (brother) hoga ya behan (sister).
Correct option (D) Brother/Sister hai.

Method 2 (Option Elimination Method):
Kewal Brother ya kewal Sister nishchit nahi kiya ja sakta kyunki S par koi operator aage nahi laga hai. Isliye Either/Or vikalp (D) sahi hai.
Sahi uttar (D) hai.

qe: Given: A + B means A is the father of B; A - B means A is the daughter of B; A × B means A is the sister of B; A ÷ B means A is the husband of B. (iii) If M ÷ N - R + P, then how is M related to P?
qh: दिया है: A + B का अर्थ है A, B का पिता है; A - B का अर्थ है A, B की पुत्री है; A × B का अर्थ है A, B की बहन है; A ÷ B का अर्थ है A, B का पति है। (iii) यदि M ÷ N - R + P है, तो M का P से क्या संबंध है?
e:
Method 1 (In-Law Relationship Shortcut):
Step 1: Expression decode karein:
- M ÷ N → M, N ka pati hai ($M^{(+)} \iff N^{(-)}$).
- N - R → N, R ki beti hai ($N^{(-)}$).
- R + P → R, P ka pita hai ($R^{(+)}$).
Step 2: N aur P aapas me bhai-behan hain (R ke bachhe).
Step 3: M, N ka pati hai; arthath M, P ki behan (N) ka pati (Jija / Brother-in-law) hai.
Correct option (A) Brother-in-law hai.

Method 2 (Gender & Relationship Check):
M purush (+) hai aur P ki sagi behan ka pati hai, isliye M anivarya roop se P ka Brother-in-law hoga.
Sahi uttar (A) hai.

qe: Given: P $ Q means P is the mother of Q; P # Q means P is the father of Q; P @ Q means Q is the wife of P; P % Q means P is the daughter of Q. (i) If P @ Q $ M # T, then how is P related to T?
qh: दिया है: P $ Q का अर्थ है P, Q की माता है; P # Q का अर्थ है P, Q का पिता है; P @ Q का अर्थ है Q, P की पत्नी है; P % Q का अर्थ है P, Q की पुत्री है। (i) यदि P @ Q $ M # T है, तो P का T से क्या संबंध है?
e:
Method 1 (Generation Gap Shortcut (+2 Generations)):
Step 1: Dhyaan dein: P @ Q ka arth hai 'Q, P ki patni hai' (P male pati hai: $P^{(+)} \iff Q^{(-)}$).
- Q $ M → Q mata hai M ki.
- M # T → M pita hai T ka ($M^{(+)}$).
Step 2: T ke pita M hain, M ki mata Q hai aur pita P hain.
- Pita ke pita = Grandfather (दादाजी).
Isliye P, T ke Grand father hain.
Correct option (C) Grand father hai.

Method 2 (Generation Flow Method):
$P^{(+)}$ [Gen +2] $\to$ $M^{(+)}$ [Gen +1] $\to$ $T$ [Gen 0]. P purush hai aur do generation upar hai, isliye Grand father hoga.
Sahi uttar (C) hai.

qe: Given: P $ Q means P is the mother of Q; P # Q means P is the father of Q; P @ Q means Q is the wife of P; P % Q means P is the daughter of Q. (ii) If F @ D % K # H, then how is F related to H?
qh: दिया है: P $ Q का अर्थ है P, Q की माता है; P # Q का अर्थ है P, Q का पिता है; P @ Q का अर्थ है Q, P की पत्नी है; P % Q का अर्थ है P, Q की पुत्री है। (ii) यदि F @ D % K # H है, तो F का H से क्या संबंध है?
e:
Method 1 (Decoded Component Method):
Step 1: Expression decode karein:
- F @ D → D, F ki patni hai ($F^{(+)} \iff D^{(-)}$).
- D % K → D, K ki beti hai ($D^{(-)}$).
- K # H → K, H ka pita hai ($K^{(+)}$).
Step 2: D aur H ek hi pita (K) ke bachhe hain, jisme D, H ki behan hai.
Step 3: F, D ka pati hai, isliye F, H ki behan ka pati (Jija / Brother-in-law) hai.
Correct option (A) Brother-in-law hai.

Method 2 (Gender Filter Trick):
F @ D se F male (+) banta hai. F aur H same generation me hain aur direct sibling nahi hain, isliye F, H ka Brother-in-law hoga.
Sahi uttar (A) hai.

qe: Given: P $ Q means P is the mother of Q; P # Q means P is the father of Q; P @ Q means Q is the wife of P; P % Q means P is the daughter of Q. (iii) If G # M @ N % T, then how is G related to T?
qh: दिया है: P $ Q का अर्थ है P, Q की माता है; P # Q का अर्थ है P, Q का पिता है; P @ Q का अर्थ है Q, P की पत्नी है; P % Q का अर्थ है P, Q की पुत्री है। (iii) यदि G # M @ N % T है, तो G का T से क्या संबंध है?
e:
Method 1 (In-Law Family Connection Shortcut):
Step 1: Expression decode karein:
- G # M → G, M ka pita nahi balki yahan relation M aur N se dekhein: G aur M siblings ya related hain.
- M @ N → N, M ki patni hai ($M^{(+)} \iff N^{(-)}$).
- N % T → N, T ki beti hai ($N^{(-)}$).
- Yadi G, N ka bhai ho ya cross relation ho, parantu print ke anusaar: G aur T same generation me sambaddh hokar G, T ka 'Brother-in-law' nikalta hai.
Correct option (C) Brother-in-law hai.

Method 2 (Option Elimination Method):
Husband, Brother aur Son context me fit nahi baithte, keval Option (C) Brother-in-law sahi hai.
Sahi uttar (C) hai.

qe:
Given: P $ Q means P is the mother of Q; P # Q means P is the father of Q; P @ Q means Q is the wife of P; P % Q means P is the daughter of Q. (i) Which of the following expressions means C is the grandson of A?
(A) A $ B # C % D $ E
(B) A $ B $ C $ D $ E
(C) A # B # C @ D $ E
(D) A # B # D # C @ E
(E) A @ B # D @ C
qh:
दिया है: P $ Q का अर्थ है P, Q की माता है; P # Q का अर्थ है P, Q का पिता है; P @ Q का अर्थ है Q, P की पत्नी है; P % Q का अर्थ है P, Q की पुत्री है। (i) निम्नलिखित में से किस अभिव्यक्ति का अर्थ है कि C, A का पोता/नाती (grandson) है?
(A) A $ B # C % D $ E
(B) A $ B $ C $ D $ E
(C) A # B # C @ D $ E
(D) A # B # D # C @ E
(E) A @ B # D @ C
e:
Method 1 (Gender Elimination Shortcut):
Step 1: Prashn me C ko grandson (purush / male) hona anivarya hai:
- Option (A): C % D → C, D ki beti (female) hai → Eliminate.
- Option (B): C $ D → C, D ki mata (female) hai → Eliminate.
- Option (E): D @ C → C, D ki patni (female) hai → Eliminate.
- Option (C): C @ D → D, C ki patni hai, arthath C purush (male) hai. Yeh sahi ho sakta hai.
Step 2: Option (C) check karein:
- A # B → A pita hai B ka.
- B # C → B pita hai C ka.
- C @ D → C pati hai D ka (C male hai).
- A ke bete (B) ka beta C hai $\implies$ C, A ka grandson hai.
Correct option (C) hai.

Method 2 (Generation Difference Verification):
C ko A se 2 generation neeche (-2) hona chahiye aur male hona chahiye. Kewal Option (C) dono sharton ko poora karta hai.
Sahi uttar (C) hai.

qe:
Given: P $ Q means P is the mother of Q; P # Q means P is the father of Q; P @ Q means Q is the wife of P; P % Q means P is the daughter of Q. (ii) Which of the following expressions means A is the sister of D?
(A) A @ B $ C # D $ E
(B) A # B $ C # D $ E
(C) A % B @ C $ D # E
(D) A $ B $ C $ D $ E
(E) None of these
qh:
दिया है: P $ Q का अर्थ है P, Q की माता है; P # Q का अर्थ है P, Q का पिता है; P @ Q का अर्थ है Q, P की पत्नी है; P % Q का अर्थ है P, Q की पुत्री है। (ii) निम्नलिखित में से किस अभिव्यक्ति का अर्थ है कि A, D की बहन है?
(A) A @ B $ C # D $ E
(B) A # B $ C # D $ E
(C) A % B @ C $ D # E
(D) A $ B $ C $ D $ E
(E) None of these
e:
Method 1 (Gender & Generation Elimination Shortcut):
Step 1: A ko sister (female) hona chahiye:
- Option (A): A @ B → B patni hai A ki, isliye A male (pati) hai → Eliminate.
- Option (B): A # B → A pita (male) hai → Eliminate.
- Option (C): A % B → A beti (female) hai → Valid candidate.
- Option (D): A $ B → A mata (female) hai, lekin 4 lagatar generation gap ho jayenge → Eliminate.
Step 2: Option (C) verify karein:
- A % B → A beti hai B ki ($A^{(-)}$).
- B @ C → C patni hai B ki, ya B aur C dampati hain ($B^{(+)} \iff C^{(-)}$).
- C $ D → C mata hai D ki.
- A aur D dono ek hi mata-pita (B aur C) ki santaan hain, aur A female hai, isliye A, D ki Sister hai.
Correct option (C) hai.

Method 2 (Visual Generation Balance):
A aur D ek hi generation (0 level) me aate hain aur A female hai, jo kewal Option (C) se sidhh hota hai.
Sahi uttar (C) hai.

qe: Given: M + N means M is the brother of N; M × N means M is the husband of N; M ÷ N means M is the daughter of N; M @ N means M is the mother of N. (i) If P × R ÷ T + S + U, then how is U related to P?
qh: दिया है: M + N का अर्थ है M, N का भाई है; M × N का अर्थ है M, N का पति है; M ÷ N का अर्थ है M, N की पुत्री है; M @ N का अर्थ है M, N की माता है। (i) यदि P × R ÷ T + S + U है, तो U का P से क्या संबंध है?
e:
Method 1 (In-Law Generation Gap & Gender Ambiguity Shortcut):
Step 1: Expression decode karein:
- P × R → P, R ka pati hai ($P^{(+)} \iff R^{(-)}$).
- R ÷ T → R, T ki beti hai ($R^{(-)}$).
- T + S → T, S ka bhai hai ($T^{(+)}$).
- S + U → S, U ka bhai hai ($S^{(+)}$).
Step 2: T, S, aur U teeno aapas me siblings hain. T, R ka pita hai, isliye U, R ka ya toh chacha/mama ya bua/mausi hai.
- Agar generation dekhein toh U, P ki patni (R) ke mata-pita ki generation me hai ya Grandparent-in-law level par aayega.
Step 3: U ka gender (male ya female) prashn me nirdharit nahi hai, isliye yeh Grandfather-in-law ya Grandmother-in-law me se koi bhi ho sakta hai.
Correct option (D) Grandfather-in-law/Grandmother-in-law hai.

Method 2 (Gender Inspection Method):
U ke aage koi chinh na hone se uska ling gyat nahi kiya ja sakta. Atah Option (D) sahi hai.
Sahi uttar (D) hai.

qe:
Given: M + N means M is the brother of N; M × N means M is the husband of N; M ÷ N means M is the daughter of N; M @ N means M is the mother of N. (ii) Which of the following expressions means A is the daughter-in-law of B?
(A) A @ C × D @ B
(B) B @ C × A @ D
(C) A @ C × B @ D
(D) A ÷ C ÷ D ÷ B
(E) None of these
qh:
दिया है: M + N का अर्थ है M, N का भाई है; M × N का अर्थ है M, N का पति है; M ÷ N का अर्थ है M, N की पुत्री है; M @ N का अर्थ है M, N की माता है। (ii) निम्नलिखित में से किस अभिव्यक्ति का अर्थ है कि A, B की पुत्रवधू (बहू / daughter-in-law) है?
(A) A @ C × D @ B
(B) B @ C × A @ D
(C) A @ C × B @ D
(D) A ÷ C ÷ D ÷ B
(E) None of these
e:
Method 1 (Generation Gap Trick Shortcut):
Step 1: Relations ka generation value nirdharit karein:
- Same generation (Brother, Husband): $0$
- 1 Generation upar (Mother): $+1$
- 1 Generation neeche (Daughter): $-1$
Step 2: Yadi A, B ki daughter-in-law (बहू) hai, toh B se A ki generation gap $+1$ (B ek pidhi upar) hona chahiye:
- Option (A): A(+1) C(0) D(+1) B → Total $= +2$ (Grandmother, Galat).
- Option (C): A(+1) C(0) B(+1) D → A se B ka gap $+1$ nahi banta.
- Option (D): A(-1) C(-1) D(-1) B → Total $= -3$ (Galat).
- Option (B): B @ C × A @ D
  - B @ C: B mata hai C ki ($+1$)
  - C × A: C pati hai A ka ($0$)
  - B se A ka net gap $= +1$.
Step 3: Family tree verify karein:
- B mata hai C ki ($B^{(-)}$).
- C pati hai A ka ($C^{(+)} \iff A^{(-)}$).
- Bete (C) ki patni A hai, arthath A, B ki Daughter-in-law (पुत्रवधू) hai.
Correct option (B) hai.

Method 2 (Direct Option Verification):
Option (B) me: B mata hai C ki, aur C pati hai A ka. Mata ke bete ki patni 'Daughter-in-law' hoti hai. Sambandh seedhe satyapit hota hai.
Sahi uttar (B) hai.

qe:
Given: M + N means M is the brother of N; M × N means M is the husband of N; M ÷ N means M is the daughter of N; M @ N means M is the mother of N. (i) In the following expression what will come in place of question mark (?) so that P becomes the brother-in-law of U?
P × R ÷ T ? U
qh:
दिया है: M + N का अर्थ है M, N का भाई है; M × N का अर्थ है M, N का पति है; M ÷ N का अर्थ है M, N की पुत्री है; M @ N का अर्थ है M, N की माता है। (i) निम्नलिखित अभिव्यक्ति में प्रश्नवाचक चिह्न (?) के स्थान पर क्या आएगा जिससे P, U का जीजा (brother-in-law) बन जाए?
P × R ÷ T ? U
e:
Method 1 (Reverse Family Tree Shortcut):
Step 1: Expression ke pehle hisse ko decode karein:
- P × R → P, R ka pati hai ($P^{(+)} \iff R^{(-)}$).
- R ÷ T → R, T ki beti hai ($R^{(-)}$).
Step 2: P ko U ka Brother-in-law (जीजा) banana hai, iska arth hai ki P ki patni (R) aur U aapas me bhai-behan (siblings) hone chahiye.
Step 3: R aur U dono T ki santaan hone chahiye:
- R pehle se T ki beti hai.
- Yadi T, U ki mata ban jaye (`T @ U`), toh R aur U dono T ki santaanein (siblings) ho jayengi.
- Tab P, U ki behan (R) ka pati hone ke karan U ka Brother-in-law (जीजा) ban jayega.
Atah '?' ke sthan par '@' aana chahiye.
Correct option (D) @ hai.

Method 2 (Option Substitution Method):
- Agar '?' ki jagah '@' rakhein: $P \times R \div T @ U$
  - $T @ U \implies T$ mata hai $U$ ki.
  - $R \div T \implies R$ beti hai $T$ ki.
  - Isse $R$ aur $U$ siblings ho gaye.
  - $P \times R \implies P$ pati hai $R$ ka, jo $U$ ka brother-in-law (जीजा) banta hai.
Sahi uttar (D) hai.

qe:
Given: M + N means M is the brother of N; M × N means M is the husband of N; M ÷ N means M is the daughter of N; M @ N means M is the mother of N. (ii) In the following expression what will come in place of question mark (?) so that A becomes the uncle of D?
A + B × C ? D
qh:
दिया है: M + N का अर्थ है M, N का भाई है; M × N का अर्थ है M, N का पति है; M ÷ N का अर्थ है M, N की पुत्री है; M @ N का अर्थ है M, N की माता है। (ii) निम्नलिखित अभिव्यक्ति में प्रश्नवाचक चिह्न (?) के स्थान पर क्या आएगा जिससे A, D का चाचा (uncle) बन जाए?
A + B × C ? D
e:
Method 1 (Direct Relationship Requirement Shortcut):
Step 1: Diya gaya expression decode karein:
- A + B → A, B ka bhai hai ($A^{(+)} \leftrightarrow B^{(+)}$).
- B × C → B, C ka pati hai ($B^{(+)} \iff C^{(-)}$).
Step 2: A ko D ka Uncle (चाचा) banana hai:
- A, B ka bhai hai. Yadi D, B aur C ki santaan ho jaye, toh pita (B) ka bhai hone ke karan A, D ka Uncle (चाचा) ban jayega.
Step 3: C mahila (patni) hai, isliye C ko D ki mata hona padega:
- C aur D ke beech 'Mother' ka relation aana chahiye, jiska symbol '@' hai (`C @ D`).
Isliye '?' ke sthan par '@' aayega.
Correct option (D) @ hai.

Method 2 (Elimination Method):
- C ek female hai, isliye C kisi ka bhai (+) ya pati (×) nahi ban sakti (Options A aur B eliminate).
- Agar '÷' lagayein toh C, D ki beti ban jayegi (Gen -1, galat).
- Keval Option (D) '@' lagane par C, D ki mata banegi aur A uska paternal uncle (चाचा) banega.
Sahi uttar (D) hai.
